```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent))

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

from ingest.common import SERVICES, kpi_periods, read_table

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=False)
BLUE, ORANGE = "#2E75B6", "#C55A11"

def none_msg(what):
    return Markdown(f"*No {what} data yet. Run the matching ingest script (see README).*")

def hbar(counts: pd.Series, title="", xlabel="Respondents"):
    d = counts.sort_values().reset_index()
    d.columns = ["label", "n"]
    fig = px.bar(d, x="n", y="label", orientation="h", text="n", title=title,
                 color_discrete_sequence=[BLUE], labels={"n": xlabel, "label": ""})
    fig.update_layout(height=max(260, 28 * len(d) + 90), margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=40, b=10))
    return fig

def per_period(dates: pd.Series, label="Per period"):
    dates = dates.dropna()
    span = (dates.max() - dates.min()).days if len(dates) else 0
    freq = "D" if span <= 60 else ("W" if span <= 365 else "MS")
    s = dates.dt.floor("D").value_counts().sort_index().resample(freq).sum()
    d = pd.DataFrame({"date": s.index, label: s.values, "Cumulative": s.cumsum().values})
    fig = px.bar(d, x="date", y=label, color_discrete_sequence=[BLUE])
    fig.add_scatter(x=d.date, y=d.Cumulative, name="Cumulative", yaxis="y2", line=dict(color=ORANGE, width=2))
    fig.update_layout(yaxis2=dict(overlaying="y", side="right", title="Cumulative", showgrid=False),
                      legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.1), margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=30, b=10), xaxis_title="")
    return fig

resp = read_table("survey_respondents")
choices = read_table("survey_choices")
gh_daily = read_table("github_daily")
issues = read_table("github_issues")
contribs = read_table("github_contributors")
releases = read_table("github_releases")
traffic = read_table("github_traffic")
dc_daily = read_table("discord_daily")
dc_msgs = read_table("discord_messages")
dc_members = read_table("discord_members")

commits = read_table("github_commits")
discussions = read_table("github_discussions")
repo_services = read_table("github_repo_services")
pkg_dl = read_table("package_downloads")
pkg_services = read_table("package_services")
issues_all = issues  # funder KPIs count every opener, bots included (see FUNDER_METRICS.md)

n_resp = len(resp) if resp is not None else 0
if issues is not None:
    issues = issues[~issues.is_bot]
if dc_msgs is not None:
    dc_msgs = dc_msgs[~dc_msgs.author_is_bot]
if dc_members is not None:
    dc_members = dc_members[~dc_members.is_bot]
    dc_current = dc_members[dc_members.left_seen.isna()]
updated = pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%d %b %Y %H:%M")
```

# Funder KPIs

```{python}
#| include: false
PERIODS = kpi_periods()
PLABELS = [p[0] for p in PERIODS]

def in_periods(dates):
    """Number of non-null timestamps falling in each reporting period."""
    d = pd.Series(dates).dropna()
    return [int(((d >= a) & (d < b)).sum()) for _, a, b in PERIODS]

def uniq_in_periods(df, date_col, key):
    return [int(df.loc[(df[date_col] >= a) & (df[date_col] < b), key].nunique()) for _, a, b in PERIODS]

def repo_metrics(repos):
    """Activity metrics summed over `repos` (each repo counted once)."""
    rows = {}
    if issues_all is not None:
        i = issues_all[issues_all.repo.isin(repos)]
        rows["Merged pull requests"] = in_periods(i.loc[i.is_pr, "merged_at"])
        rows["Pull requests opened"] = in_periods(i.loc[i.is_pr, "created_at"])
        rows["Issues opened"] = in_periods(i.loc[~i.is_pr, "created_at"])
        rows["Issues closed"] = in_periods(i.loc[~i.is_pr, "closed_at"])
        disc = discussions[discussions.repo.isin(repos)].created_at if discussions is not None else []
        rows["Support requests (issues + discussions opened)"] = [
            a + b for a, b in zip(rows["Issues opened"], in_periods(disc))]
    if discussions is not None:
        rows["Discussions opened"] = in_periods(discussions[discussions.repo.isin(repos)].created_at)
    if commits is not None:
        # forks / template syncs share history: count each sha once, and show what is not shared
        c = commits[commits.repo.isin(repos)].drop_duplicates("sha")
        rows["Commits (default branch)"] = in_periods(c.authored_at)
        rows["Commits not shared with another tracked repo"] = in_periods(
            c.loc[~c.sha.isin(SHARED_SHAS), "authored_at"])
        rows["Non-merge commits"] = in_periods(c.loc[~c.is_merge, "authored_at"])
        h = c[~c.is_bot & c.author.notna()]
        rows["Human commit authors"] = uniq_in_periods(h, "authored_at", "author")
    if releases is not None:
        r = releases[releases.repo.isin(repos)].drop_duplicates(["repo", "tag"])
        rows["Releases published (incl. prereleases)"] = in_periods(r.published_at)
    if gh_daily is not None and not gh_daily.empty:
        rows["Stars added (net, from nightly counts)"] = net_stars(repos)
    return rows

def net_stars(repos):
    """Net star change per period from the nightly counts; '–' unless a count exists at/before the start."""
    d = gh_daily[gh_daily.repo.isin(repos)].sort_values("date")
    out = []
    for _, a, b in PERIODS:
        vals = []
        for _, g in d.groupby("repo"):
            before, upto = g[g.date <= a], g[g.date < b]
            if before.empty or upto.empty:
                vals = None
                break
            vals.append(int(upto.stars.iloc[-1]) - int(before.stars.iloc[-1]))
        out.append(sum(vals) if vals else "–")
    return out

def downloads(channel, package):
    """Downloads per period; '–' where no month of the period has been collected."""
    d = pkg_dl[(pkg_dl.channel == channel) & (pkg_dl.package == package)]
    out = []
    for _, a, b in PERIODS:
        m = d[(d.month >= a) & (d.month < b)]
        out.append(int(m.downloads.sum()) if len(m) else "–")
    return out

def kpi_table(rows, first_cols):
    df = pd.DataFrame([{**first_cols(k), **dict(zip(PLABELS, v))} for k, v in rows])
    return df

SHARED_SHAS = (set(commits.loc[commits.duplicated("sha", keep=False), "sha"])
               if commits is not None else set())
ORDER = ["Support requests (issues + discussions opened)", "Issues closed", "Merged pull requests",
         "Commits (default branch)", "Commits not shared with another tracked repo", "Human commit authors", "Releases published (incl. prereleases)"]
all_repos = sorted((set(repo_services.repo) if repo_services is not None else set())
                   | (set(issues_all.repo) if issues_all is not None else set()))
```

```{python}
#| title: By service package
rows = []
for key, label in SERVICES.items():
    repos = repo_services.loc[repo_services.service == key, "repo"].tolist() if repo_services is not None else []
    if repos:
        m = repo_metrics(repos)
        rows += [((label, k), m[k]) for k in ORDER if k in m]
    if pkg_dl is not None and pkg_services is not None:
        for _, r in pkg_services[pkg_services.service == key].iterrows():
            ch = {"bioconda": "Bioconda", "pypi": "PyPI"}.get(r.channel, r.channel)
            rows.append(((label, f"{ch} {r.package} downloads"), downloads(r.channel, r.package)))
if all_repos:
    m = repo_metrics(all_repos)
    rows += [(("All tracked repos", k), m[k]) for k in ORDER if k in m]
if rows:
    df = kpi_table(rows, lambda k: {"Service package": k[0], "KPI": k[1]})
    show(df, paging=False, ordering=False,
         columnDefs=[{"className": "dt-right", "targets": list(range(2, 2 + len(PLABELS)))}])
else:
    none_msg("funder KPI (run ingest.github and ingest.packages)")
```

```{python}
#| title: How these are counted
Markdown(f"""
Columns are the last three full calendar years plus **{PLABELS[-1]}** (to {pd.Timestamp.now():%d %b %Y});
they move forward automatically each January.

- **Support requests**: every issue and discussion opened, any author (bots included); PRs excluded.
- **Issues closed** counts the current closure date, including stale/duplicate closures.
- **Commits** follow the current default branch by author date. Template syncs and forks pull
  other repos' history in (e.g. umetaflow contains streamlit-template commits), so each commit is
  counted once across repos, and "not shared" shows commits found in no other tracked repo.
  Service rows count each repo once, but one repo can serve several packages
  (e.g. OpenMS/OpenMS for Core and Python), so service rows must not be summed either.
- **Stars**: GitHub removed the stargazer list (30 June 2026), so stars added are the net change in the
  nightly star counts (“–” until a count exists at the start of the period; history starts with the
  first run).
- **Downloads** are download events (CI and dependencies included), not users. Bioconda months appear
  once Anaconda publishes them, so the YTD column lags by a month; “–” means no month collected.
- Repo-wide activity includes the wider community, not only funded work.

Not automated yet (citations, tool/workflow executions, telemetry, WebApp visits, training): see
`FUNDER_METRICS.md` in the repository.
""")
```

# Survey → activity

```{python}
#| include: false
funnel = None
if n_resp:
    f = resp[["submission_id", "submitted_at", "role", "affiliation_norm", "github_handle", "discord_handle"]].copy()
    if issues is not None:
        a = issues.groupby("author").agg(issues_opened=("is_pr", lambda x: int((~x).sum())),
                                          prs_opened=("is_pr", "sum"),
                                          first_activity=("created_at", "min"),
                                          last_activity=("created_at", "max"))
        f = f.merge(a, left_on="github_handle", right_index=True, how="left")
        after = issues.merge(f[["github_handle", "submitted_at"]], left_on="author", right_on="github_handle")
        after = after[after.created_at >= after.submitted_at].groupby("author").size().rename("gh_items_after_signup")
        f = f.merge(after, left_on="github_handle", right_index=True, how="left")
    if dc_members is not None:
        # survey handle may be a username, display name or server nickname
        names = pd.concat([dc_members[[c, "joined_at", "left_seen"]].rename(columns={c: "name"})
                           for c in ("username", "global_name", "nick")]).dropna(subset=["name"])
        names = names.sort_values("joined_at").drop_duplicates("name")
        f = f.merge(names.rename(columns={"name": "discord_handle", "joined_at": "discord_joined",
                                          "left_seen": "discord_left"}), on="discord_handle", how="left")
        f["joined_after_signup"] = f.discord_joined >= f.submitted_at
    if dc_msgs is not None:
        m = dc_msgs.groupby("author").agg(discord_messages=("message_id", "count"),
                                          discord_last=("created_at", "max"))
        f = f.merge(m, left_on="discord_handle", right_index=True, how="left")
    funnel = f

def count(cond):
    return int(cond.sum()) if funnel is not None else 0
```
